description: Cumulative incidence (KM-style step curves), two black series told apart only by line style: TFT solid, FFT dashed (dash ~9 px, gap ~8 px). Journal figure (Takata, Fig. 1), 763x624 JPEG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis; positions are image pixels, origin top-left, +/- ~1 px.

xAxis.notes: Tick marks every 10 months below the axis (rows ~410-412); labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80. x = 0 is right of the left axis line.

yAxis.notes: Tick marks every 0.1 left of the axis (cols ~124-127); labels 0.2-1.0. y = 0 is at the x axis.

knownValues.description: Final plateau, dashed (dashes from x ~227 to ~705 px)
Step 0.755, dashed (dashes at x ~203-209 and ~217-226 px)

pitfalls: Both series are black; only the line style tells them apart. Between ~0 and ~12 months both are near-vertical staircases a few px apart that touch in places.
FFT is dashed along its verticals too; its plateau dashes have 8 px gaps, so a seed in a gap is not on the series.
The text labels TFT / FFT and 'P = 0.6395' sit inside the plot box.
